screens.title: General Settings (Shortcuts, Preferred Languages, Active Model Card, Sound)
steps: Launch upstream Vite dev server with deterministic Tauri v2 IPC test double (onboarding_completed=true, theme=light)
Load root view (General section active by default)
Wait for settingsStore, modelStore, and Footer status bar to settle

screens.title: Models Catalog (Downloaded On This Computer & Curated For Your Languages)
steps: Click Models item in left Sidebar
Wait for ModelTable to join get_available_models() with @handy-computer/models catalog
Observe Whisper Medium active row and Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 downloaded row

screens.title: Transcription History List (3 Seeded SQLite Entries, Newest First)
steps: Click History item in left Sidebar
Wait for get_history_entries(cursor=null, limit=30) backed by SQLite history.db
Observe 3 entries with UTC timestamps, copy/star/retry/delete controls, and audio bars

screens.title: Transcription History After Star Toggle (#3) and Delete (#1)
steps: On History view, click Save (Star) button on newest entry (id=3)
Click Delete (Trash) button on oldest entry (id=1)
Confirm star turns active pink on id=3 and id=1 is removed from DOM and SQLite

screens.title: Advanced Settings (App, Output, Transcription, History Retention)
steps: Click Advanced item in left Sidebar
Observe App, Output, Transcription, and History settings groups
